corrections.old_text: እምርያም ፡ የሚሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ፎጢኖስ ፡ ፩ ፡ ገጽ ፡ የሚል ፡ ሰባልዮስ ፡ ፍጡር ፡ የ↵
corrections.corrected_text: እምማርያም ፡ የሚሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ፎጢኖስ ፡ ፩ ፡ ገጽ ፡ የሚል ፡ ሰባልዮስ ፡ ፍጡር ፡ የ
corrections.reason: Looking closely at the print at the start of Col 2 L13, the characters are 'እምማርያም' (the Photinian heresy 'ለፌ እምማርያም', claiming Christ's beginning was only from Mary), though the 'ም' and 'ማ' are tightly kerning/ligatured.
